description: Field-level change events computed between held EMA snapshot generations: per medicine when an identity is given ({ema_product_number}, or a resolved {name} / {inn}), feed-wide (all held product numbers, capped at 100 events per call, truncation flagged) when only {since} is given. Event types: added, status_changed, revision_advanced, procedure_updated, withdrawn_or_suspended_transition (a labelled subcase of status_changed, emitted additionally), field_changed — computed only from held diffs and source stamps, never inferred. since is a generation id or a UTC timestamp; a since before the first held generation is clamped to it and the clamp is stated in the payload; with no since, the window is the latest consecutive pair only. An unchanged medicine in the window delivers an explicit empty events list with covered:true — a delivered answer, not an error. Every payload carries the EMA acknowledgement + official-text-prevails lines. Free pre-check at POST /toll/ema/changes/preflight (tool ema_changes_preflight). Price: $0.01 per call (RULED). — USDC on Solana via x402 (over MCP: call without payment to get the PaymentRequired challenge, then retry with the payment at _meta["x402/payment"]). HTTP equivalent: POST https://exchangerebel.com/toll/ema/changes.
name: ema_changes
